name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopia–Tigray fighting continues and Eritrea tensions persist; Afghan–Pakistan border clashes reported on 5 Nov
state: Federal and Tigrayan forces reportedly clashed around Egela on 2–3 Nov, while reports of Ethiopian–Eritrean clashes on 30 Oct–1 Nov could not be confirmed (Critical Threats). A US Congressional Research Service paper published on 7 Nov says the two countries appear to be preparing for war, so an interstate war remains unconfirmed. Pakistan Observer reported on 5 Nov an exchange of fire between Pakistani forces and the Afghan Taliban in Kurram, not confirmed by Pakistan's military. Searches on 8 Nov found no capital under attack.
for_you: Civilians in Tigray, Amhara and along the Afghan–Pakistan border are most exposed. Wider fighting in the Horn of Africa tends to affect aid access and Red Sea trade. FCDO travel advice is the official reference for both regions.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration in Ethiopia since September. Alert line (new interstate war) unconfirmed: direct Ethiopia–Eritrea combat is not verified as of 8 Nov.
